messages:
maya: Flagging a narrow scope for procurement-heavy customers: they require contractual guarantees that retention data never leaves EU and a clear export escrow path. Need quick alignment on what we can commit for MVP.

samira: Security: region-locking + BYOK region-scoped keys are must-haves. Also require immutable audit entries for who requested exports.

jonah: Tech: we can do region-locked storage and region-local export workers. Cross-region search is harder; for procurement customers we should disable cross-region indexing.

alejandro: Legal: procurement clauses often want physical separation or an explicit escrow. For MVP we can offer an export-to-customer-storage clause + signed evidence pack. Anything beyond that needs sales/legal review.

lina: Product: propose MVP commitments: EU-only storage, manifest within 48h, quoted bulk ETA, BYOK pilot allowed (no HSM). GA HSM attestations later.

ops-bot: ops-bot: Reminder: exports >1TB require cost-ack and ops runbook owner. Ops suggests pilot with manual exports to avoid spinning regional infra.

samira: Security will draft the EU-BYOK checklist and the immutable-log spec. Add: require customer-provided KMS ARN scoped to EU region.

maya: Action items: jonah 1w spike for region-local export worker feasibility, samira BYOK checklist (3d), alejandro procurement clause template (3d), lina to draft customer-facing commitments. I will post a short procurement FAQ in the compliance drive.
